about.title: Our story.
about.text1: Founded in 2013, Loops Technologies has always been about one thing: purely technology-driven solutions. We aren't just developers, we are partners in your growth.
about.text2: Founder Mukarram Hussain has spent over 10 years perfecting the art of software engineering. His expertise in PHP, Laravel and modern JavaScript frameworks is the foundation of everything we build.
about.text3: Today, we operate from Riyadh and Lahore, bringing together the best talent to serve clients in the Middle East and beyond with honesty and excellence.
